lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: [curious] What if you could hear what EVERYONE was thinking? Every secret. Every lie. [mischievously] Even what your crush ACTUALLY thinks about you.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: [warmly] Well... one morning, Noah woke up with exactly that power.

lines.speaker: barista
lines.text: [cheerfully] Here you go! Have a great day!

lines.speaker: barista
lines.text: [nervous] [softly] Please don't spill it. Please don't spill it.

lines.speaker: noah
lines.text: [shocked] WHAT THE—

lines.speaker: barista
lines.text: [panicked] [softly] I'm getting fired.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: At first, he thought he was losing his mind. [pause] But when he walked outside... he realized he could hear EVERY single person around him.

lines.speaker: businessman
lines.text: [casually] Yes, boss. Almost at the office.

lines.speaker: businessman
lines.text: [stressed] [softly] I'm still twenty minutes away.

lines.speaker: woman
lines.text: [worried] [softly] Did I leave the oven on?

lines.speaker: man
lines.text: [suspicious] [softly] Why is that kid staring at me?

lines.speaker: noah
lines.text: [breathless] [amazed] Oh my god. This is actually real.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: [excited] And once Noah figured out how it worked, he realized something even crazier. He could use it to get basically ANYTHING he wanted.

lines.speaker: teacher
lines.text: Noah. What's the answer to question seven?

lines.speaker: noah
lines.text: [nervous] Uh...

lines.speaker: teacher
lines.text: [exasperated] [softly] Please don't say C again. It's B.

lines.speaker: noah
lines.text: [confidently] B!

lines.speaker: teacher
lines.text: [surprised] ...Correct.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: [playfully] Suddenly, school wasn't so difficult anymore.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: [softly] But there was one person Noah wanted to read more than anyone. [pause] Maya. The girl he'd been too scared to talk to for almost a year.

lines.speaker: maya
lines.text: [softly] [curious] Wait... Noah actually looks kinda cute today.

lines.speaker: noah
lines.text: [whispers] No way.

lines.speaker: maya
lines.text: [softly] [confused] Why is he smiling like that?

lines.speaker: noah
lines.text: [embarrassed] Oh.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: For the first few hours, Noah thought he'd become the luckiest person alive. [pause] [ominously] Until he walked into the school cafeteria.

lines.speaker: noah
lines.text: [nervous] Wait. Wait, hold on—

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: You see, hearing one person's thoughts was amazing. [pause] Hearing TWO HUNDRED people's thoughts at once? [pause] [deadpan] Not so much.

lines.speaker: crowd_a
lines.text: [softly] I'm starving.

lines.speaker: crowd_b
lines.text: [softly] [annoyed] Why did she leave me on read?

lines.speaker: crowd_c
lines.text: [softly] [tired] I hate Mondays.

lines.speaker: crowd_d
lines.text: [softly] [anxious] Did I fail chemistry?

lines.speaker: crowd_e
lines.text: [softly] [sad] Does anyone even like me?

lines.speaker: woman
lines.text: [softly] Is my hair weird today?

lines.speaker: businessman
lines.text: [softly] Two more periods. Just two more.

lines.speaker: man
lines.text: [softly] I should have studied.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: [seriously] Everyone was thinking something different. And Noah couldn't turn ANY of it off.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: He tried covering his ears. [pause] Nothing. [pause] He tried headphones. [pause] Still nothing. [pause] He even locked himself in an empty bathroom.

lines.speaker: noah
lines.text: [frustrated] [shouting] ARE YOU KIDDING ME?

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: [seriously] But the worst thing Noah heard that day wasn't from a stranger. [pause] It came from Leo. His best friend since they were kids.

lines.speaker: leo
lines.text: [casually] Yo, you coming over Friday?

lines.speaker: leo
lines.text: [softly] [sad] I can't keep doing this.

lines.speaker: noah
lines.text: [confused] [softly] ...Doing what?

lines.speaker: leo
lines.text: [confused] What?

lines.speaker: leo
lines.text: [softly] [anxious] I have to tell him. He's gonna hate me.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: Noah couldn't stop thinking about what he'd heard. [pause] Was Leo planning to ditch him? Had he been lying this whole time? [pause] And the more Noah listened... the worse it got.

lines.speaker: leo
lines.text: [softly] [frustrated] I wish he'd stop asking.

lines.speaker: leo
lines.text: [softly] [determined] Friday. I have to do it Friday.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: [ominously] By the end of the day, Noah was convinced his best friend was hiding something terrible.

lines.speaker: maya
lines.text: [gently] Hey, Noah. You okay?

lines.speaker: maya
lines.text: [softly] [worried] He seems really upset.

lines.speaker: noah
lines.text: [curtly] I'm fine.

lines.speaker: maya
lines.text: [softly] [hesitant] I want to help, but I don't know what to say.

lines.speaker: noah
lines.text: [angry] [shouting] Then don't say ANYTHING!

lines.speaker: maya
lines.text: [hurt] [quietly] ...What?

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: [softly] And that's when Noah realized something. [pause] Just because he could HEAR a thought... didn't mean he understood it.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: But there was still one question he couldn't get out of his head. [pause] What was Leo planning to tell him on Friday?

lines.speaker: leo
lines.text: [softly] [nervous] Tomorrow's going to change everything.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: Friday finally came. [pause] And Noah wasn't going to wait around for Leo to tell him.

lines.speaker: noah
lines.text: [coldly] So. What were you gonna tell me?

lines.speaker: leo
lines.text: [surprised] What?

lines.speaker: noah
lines.text: [bitter] Don't act like you don't know.

lines.speaker: leo
lines.text: [softly] [panicked] Oh no. Not like this.

lines.speaker: noah
lines.text: [hurt] You've been hiding something from me all week.

lines.speaker: leo
lines.text: [pleading] Noah, just let me explain.

lines.speaker: leo
lines.text: [softly] [worried] He's gonna think I'm abandoning him.

lines.speaker: noah
lines.text: [angry] So you ARE abandoning me?

lines.speaker: leo
lines.text: [shocked] How did you—

lines.speaker: noah
lines.text: [shouting] I KNOW what you're thinking, Leo!

lines.speaker: leo
lines.text: [hesitant] I got accepted into a school overseas.

lines.speaker: noah
lines.text: [stunned] [quietly] ...What?

lines.speaker: leo
lines.text: Full scholarship. My mom's already sorting everything out.

lines.speaker: noah
lines.text: [hurt] And you were just gonna leave without telling me?

lines.speaker: leo
lines.text: [earnest] No! I was trying to figure out HOW to tell you.

lines.speaker: leo
lines.text: [softly] [hopeful] Please just be happy for me.

lines.speaker: noah
lines.text: [quietly] You said you couldn't keep doing this.

lines.speaker: leo
lines.text: [sadly] Yeah. Pretending everything was normal... while I knew I was leaving.

lines.speaker: noah
lines.text: [softly] And you thought I'd hate you?

lines.speaker: leo
lines.text: [trembling voice] I was scared you'd think I chose a new life over being your friend.

lines.speaker: leo
lines.text: [softly] [sincere] I wanted you to be the first person I told.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: [softly] And suddenly... Noah understood. [pause] All day, he'd been hearing people's thoughts. But he'd been treating every passing fear, every unfinished sentence, and every private worry... like it was the whole truth. [pause] He could hear what people were thinking. [long pause] He still didn't know what they meant.

lines.speaker: noah
lines.text: [amazed] Dude. You're actually getting a FULL scholarship?

lines.speaker: leo
lines.text: [shy] Yeah.

lines.speaker: noah
lines.text: [excited] That's insane! Why didn't you just tell me?

lines.speaker: leo
lines.text: [laughs] I was TRYING to.

lines.speaker: noah
lines.text: [warmly] ...I'm happy for you, man.

lines.speaker: leo
lines.text: [softly] [relieved] Thank god.

lines.speaker: noah
lines.text: [laughs] [laughs harder]

lines.speaker: leo
lines.text: [laughs] Ha... [laughs]

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: [playfully] Of course, Noah still had one person he was too scared to ask about.

lines.speaker: maya
lines.text: [shyly] Hey. You want to walk home together?

lines.speaker: maya
lines.text: [softly] [nervous] Please say yes.

lines.speaker: noah
lines.text: [warmly] Yeah. I'd like that.
